description: One audit an operation answers to, as a record the Desk can offer in a picker. Seeded from erpnext_mcp/training.py REGIMES on every migrate and never typed: the tuple in code is still what decides what a regime IS, and this table exists so a Table MultiSelect on Compliance Alert and Training Type has something to link to. A row added by hand is left alone by the seeder, which is how an operation with a scheme this app has never heard of records it.

fields.description: The canonical spelling, and the docname. FSMA, GAP, GlobalGAP, PrimusGFS, NOP, OTCO, WPS, OR-OSHA, Internal, Other. Spelling is load-bearing rather than cosmetic: 'OSHA' where the vocabulary says 'OR-OSHA' is evidence filed where no packet looks for it, which is why erpnext_mcp/training.py refuses a near-miss instead of correcting it.
fields.label: Regime

fields.description: Untick to keep a regime this operation no longer answers to out of new pickers. It does NOT retag anything: records already carrying it keep carrying it, because a GlobalGAP record from the year the operation held the certificate is still evidence about that year.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: Years a record carrying this tag has to be kept. Informational here — the authoritative answer is computed per record by training.retention_years, where the LONGEST tag on a record governs, because destroying a GAP-and-NOP record at two years would destroy the NOP evidence.
fields.label: Retention (years)

fields.description: The rule, in the words the rule uses, with its citation. What somebody choosing a tag reads so they are choosing against the regulation rather than against a guess.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Where the retention figure comes from. Kept beside the number because a retention period nobody can cite is a retention period somebody will shorten.
fields.label: Retention Citation

name: Compliance Regime
